annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Directive 2014/10/EU amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead in alloys used in cryo-cooler cold heads in medical devices and industrial monitoring and control instruments
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Directive 2014/10/EU amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead in alloys used in cryo-cooler cold heads in medical devices and industrial monitoring and control instruments
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Delegated Directive adding an exemption to Annex IV of the RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU for lead in alloys used in cryo-cooler cold heads and probes in medical devices and industrial monitoring and control instruments, expiring 30 June 2021. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds point 29 to Annex IV of Directive 2011/65/EU exempting lead in specified cryo-cooler alloys.
Justified because no viable lead-free alternatives exist and testing time is needed.
Member States must transpose within six months of entry into force.
